events.summary: 五帝之年：禁衛軍長官萊圖斯擁立市政官佩蒂納克斯為帝。元老院宣布康茂德為諸神之敵和國家之敵。佩蒂納克斯下令將康茂德遺體放於哈德良陵寢。萊圖斯試圖擁立執政官索修斯·法爾科為帝，被佩蒂納克斯發現後阻止。禁衛軍兵變殺死佩蒂納克斯，萊圖斯喬裝逃走。禁衛軍宣布拍賣皇位，狄狄烏斯·尤利安努斯因出價最高成為皇帝。眾元老咒罵狄狄烏斯·尤利安努斯為叛徒，狄狄烏斯·尤利安努斯命士兵襲擊元老。佩斯切尼烏斯·奈哲爾被駐敘利亞的軍團擁戴為皇帝。塞普蒂米烏斯·塞維魯於潘諾尼亞被擁立為帝並進軍羅馬。不列顛和高盧的軍隊擁戴克洛狄烏斯·阿爾比努斯為帝。元老院處死狄狄烏斯·尤利安努斯。塞普蒂米烏斯·塞維魯驅逐禁衛軍。

events.title: 新興強國弗拉基米爾－蘇茲達爾公國的大公、尤里·多爾戈魯基的長子安德烈·博戈柳布斯基進攻並洗劫基輔
events.summary: 新興強國弗拉基米爾－蘇茲達爾公國的大公、尤里·多爾戈魯基的長子安德烈·博戈柳布斯基進攻並洗劫基輔。多數羅斯大公承認他為新的大公。與先前的大公不同，安德烈一世沒有把駐地遷到基輔，而是留在弗拉基米爾，並任命弟弟格列布為基輔大公。從此基輔不再是羅斯土地的中心，政治與文化中心移到弗拉基米爾，往後的基輔大公都依附於弗拉基米爾－蘇茲達爾大公。

translation.original: Andrey Bogolyubsky, the elder son of Yuri Dolgorukiy, prince of new strong principality of Vladimir-Suzdal attacked and plundered Kiev. A majority of Russian princes recognized him as a new grand prince. Unlike previous grand princes Andrey I did not move his residence to Kiev, instead remaining in Vladimir. Andrey appointed his brother Gleb as prince of Kiev. From this time, Kiev stopped being the center of Russian lands. The political and cultural center was moved to Vladimir. New princes of Kiev became dependent on the grand princes of Vladimir-Suzdal

events.title: 在次大陸西北部發現原始人類製作的工具
events.summary: 在次大陸西北部發現原始人類製作的工具，年代可追溯到兩百萬年前。次大陸最早的考古遺址是索安河谷的舊石器時代人科遺址，索安文化遺址分布在今日印度、巴基斯坦與尼泊爾的西瓦利克地區。比姆貝特卡岩洞群中有些岩洞在十萬多年前就有直立人居住。證據顯示，直到大約七十萬年前，人科動物在印度次大陸的活動仍屬零星，到大約二十五萬年前已廣泛分布。在泰米爾納德邦清奈（舊稱馬德拉斯）附近的阿蒂蘭帕卡姆發現了馬德拉斯文化遺址，之後在這個地區的其他許多地點也發現了與這個文化相關的工具。雙面手斧與薄刃斧是這個文化典型的出土器物，另外也發現了石片工具、細石器與其他砍砸器。這些工具大多由變質岩石英岩製成，這批石器被認定屬於印度第二個間雨期。泰米爾納德邦有證據顯示，西元前 150,000 至 100,000 年間已有使用阿舍利技術的人科動物存在。

translation.original: Tools crafted by proto-humans that have been dated back two million years have been discovered in the northwestern subcontinent. The earliest archaeological site in the subcontinent is the palaeolithic hominid site in the Soan River valley. Soanian sites are found in the Sivalik region across what are now India, Pakistan, and Nepal. Some of the Bhimbetka rock shelters were inhabited by Homo erectus more than 100,000 years ago. Evidence suggested that occupation of the Indian subcontinent by hominins was sporadic until circa 700,000 years ago, and was geographically widespread by around 250,000 years ago. Madrasian culture sites have been found in Attirampakkam (Attrambakkam=13° 13' 50", 79° 53' 20"), which is located near Chennai (formerly known as Madras), Tamil Nadu. Thereafter, tools related to this culture have been found at various other locations in this region. Bifacial handaxes and cleavers are typical assemblages recovered of this culture. Flake tools, microliths and other chopping tools have also been found. Most of these tools were composed of the metamorphic rock quartzite. The stone tool artifacts in this assemblage have been identified as a part of the second inter-pluvial period in India. events.title: 印度河流域文明的一個階段開始
events.summary: 印度河流域文明的一個階段開始。這個文明使用早期形式的印度河符號，今稱「印度河文字」。在接下來的一千到一千五百年間，這個文明的居民發展出手工藝（紅玉髓製品、印章雕刻）與冶金（銅、青銅、鉛、錫）的新技術，擁有精細的城市規劃、燒磚房屋、高效的排水系統、供水系統，以及成群的大型非住宅建築。這個文明相當依賴貿易，是第一個以牛車形式使用輪式運輸的文明，也使用船隻。

translation.original: Phase of the Indus Valley Civilisation begins. The civilization used an early form of the Indus signs, now called Indus script. Over the course of the next 1000–1500 years, inhabitants of the civilization developed new techniques in handicraft (carnelian products, seal carving) and metallurgy (copper, bronze, lead, and tin) had elaborate urban planning, baked brick houses, efficient drainage systems, water supply systems, and clusters of large non-residential buildings. The civilization depended significantly on trade, was the first civilization to use wheeled transport in the form of bullock carts, and also used boats.

events.summary: 古印度數學家與天文學家婆羅摩笈多完成數理天文學著作《婆羅摩修正體系》，書中說明零的作用、正負數的運算規則、計算平方根的方法、解一次與二次方程式的方法、級數求和的規則，以及婆羅摩笈多恆等式與婆羅摩笈多定理。婆羅摩笈多把重力描述為一種吸引力，主張吸引物體是地球的本性，這與亞里斯多德認為物體會尋求「自然位置」的觀點大不相同。

translation.original: Ancient Indian mathematician and astronomer Brahmagupta completes the Brāhmasphuṭasiddhānta, a text on mathematical astronomy explaining the role of zero, rules for manipulating both negative and positive numbers, a method for computing square roots, methods of solving linear and quadratic equations, and rules for summing series, Brahmagupta's identity, and Brahmagupta's theorem. Brahmagupta described gravity as a force of attraction. He posited that it is the nature of the Earth to attract objects, a significant departure from the Aristotelian view of objects seeking their "natural place".

events.title: 拉金德拉·朱羅一世繼父親羅闍羅闍·朱羅之後成為朱羅帝國國王
events.summary: 拉金德拉·朱羅一世繼父親羅闍羅闍·朱羅之後成為朱羅帝國國王。他在位期間，把原本已經很遼闊的朱羅帝國勢力向北擴展到恆河岸邊，並越過海洋。拉金德拉的領土包括緬甸沿海、安達曼－尼科巴群島、拉克沙群島與馬爾地夫，他還以艦隊征服三佛齊（東南亞的蘇門答臘、爪哇與馬來半島）的國王與勃固。他擊敗孟加拉與比哈爾的波羅王朝國王摩希波羅，為紀念勝利建造新首都「恆河征服者朱羅城」。在他統治期間，朱羅成為亞洲最強大的王朝之一。泰米爾朱羅軍隊向泰國與柬埔寨高棉王國索取貢品。拉金德拉·朱羅一世是第一位率軍出海、征服這些地區的印度國王，不過碑文證據顯示帕拉瓦王朝也曾在這些地區活動。

translation.original: Rajendra Chola I became the king of Chola Empire after his father Rajaraja Chola. During his reign, he extended the influences of the already vast Chola empire up to the banks of the river Ganges in the north and across the ocean. Rajendra's territories extended coastal Burma, the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, Maldives, conquered the kings of Srivijaya (Sumatra, Java and Malay Peninsula in South East Asia) and Pegu islands with his fleet of ships. He defeated Mahipala, the Pala king of Bengal and Bihar, and to commemorate his victory he built a new capital called Gangaikonda Cholapuram. The Cholas became one of the most powerful dynasties in Asia during his reign. The Tamil Chola armies exacted tribute from Thailand and the Khmer kingdom of Cambodia. Rajendra Chola I was the first Indian king to take his armies overseas and make conquests of these territories, even though there is epigraphical evidence of Pallava presence in these very areas.
